title: Step invariance under output normalization
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, $n$ input positions, and work-tape radius parameter $s$. For any Boolean input $x$ of length $n$ and configuration $c$ on $x$, the observations of the one-step successors agree when the output of $c$ is replaced by its summary word: $\,\mathrm{observe}(M,n,s,x,\mathrm{step}(c))=\mathrm{observe}(M,n,s,x,\mathrm{step}(c'))$, where $c'$ agrees with $c$ except that its output is the encoding of the summary of $c$’s output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$x$ is a Boolean list of length $n$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
